programme.title: Blood and Steel: Cedar Crest Country Club
programme.desc: The story of an 80’s skateboarding mecca, tucked in the woods of a country club, that drew some of the best up-and-coming skaters and punk bands from across the country. From the mouths of the rebels who lived it, hear how one ramp became a legend. - Starring Tony Hawke, Ian MacKaye, Bucky Lasek

programme.title: Brackenmore
programme.desc: Upon news of her uncle's death, Kate must return to her family home in the tiny rural village of Brackenmore, where the eccentric, wary residents are hiding a dark secret that entangles Kate in a dangerous, cultish design.

programme.title: Border Blues
programme.desc: A dangerous smuggler helps an attractive woman and her 5-year-old daughter, while a police chief pursues a mad bomber in Los Angeles. Starring Eric Roberts, Gary Busey, Rodion Nahapetov

programme.title: Captain Orellana and the Possessed Village
programme.desc: Captain Orellana, a former police investigator has been tapped for the wackiest, most dangerous case of his long career. He’s hired to examine the strange occurrences in a remote village in which many of the villages seem to be … POSSESSED! With 007-like swagger Orellana takes on the challenge.

programme.title: Cannibal
programme.desc: Max is agoraphobic and lives in a cabin in the middle of nowhere. One night, he finds a beautiful unconscious woman (Bianca). Her body is covered with blood.

programme.title: Adventures of Power
programme.desc: In his quest to become the world's greatest air-drummer, a small-town dreamer must overcome obstacles and ridicule to save the day. Starring Ari Gold, Michael McKean, Jane Lynch

programme.title: 30 Nights of Sex
programme.desc: In a last ditch effort to save their marriage, Nick and Willa visit a renowned, yet eccentric, couples therapist and embark on a month-long journey of provocative and hilarious sex assignments. Starring Dan Fogler, Johnny Giacalone, Mandy Kaplan

programme.title: A Place to Live
programme.desc: A Place to Live follows the journey of seven LGBTQ seniors as they attempt to secure an apartment in Triangle Square, the nation's first affordable housing facility for LGBTQ seniors in Los Angeles.

programme.title: .357 - Six Bullets For Revenge
programme.desc: On her wedding night, Jade wakes up holding the hand of her dead husband after she narrowly survived a murder attempt by the criminal family she fled from only weeks before. After pawning her wedding ring for a 357 Magnum she goes after the criminals who ruined her life. Starring Fred Williamson, William Katt, Laurie Love

programme.title: Alien Exorcism
programme.desc: Dr. Davide studies alien abductions. Through hypnosis of the abductees, he has learned that several alien races have been installing, for millennia, their active memories in people's brains, to exploit a special energy: the Soul.

programme.title: After the Rain
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this provocative film follows the struggling romance between a terminal young man running out of time and a woman desperate to breathe life into his final days.

programme.title: A Crack in the Floor
programme.desc: When his self-imposed exile from society is interrupted by a group of friends on a hiking trip, a murderous hermit terrorizes the visitors. Starring Mario Lopez, Gary Busey, Bo Hopkins

programme.title: A World Away
programme.desc: Six kids take a trip to the Grand Canyon, but their flight detours into an alternate dimension, and only through growing past distrust will they be able to get back home.

programme.title: Accidental Blessing
programme.desc: Beatriz, a failed psychologist, flees to her childhood home to escape fraud charges, only to discover that her quirky aunt has turned the estate into a high school. What seems at first a terrible surprise will in fact help her finally find a fulfilling path in life as an unconventional theater instructor.
